name: yue
description: JyutTranslate — English ↔ Cantonese live translator (PWA + WordPress)

scripts.build:vercel: node scripts/compile-api-emails.mjs && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.build:web:marketing: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && VITE_BASE_PATH=./ npm run build --prefix apps/web && rm -rf dist-marketing && mkdir -p dist-marketing && cp -R apps/web/dist/. dist-marketing/
scripts.build:web:wp: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && VITE_BASE_PATH=./ npm run build --prefix apps/web && rm -rf wordpress/yue-translator/app && mkdir -p wordpress/yue-translator/app && cp -R apps/web/dist/. wordpress/yue-translator/app/
